## Personality

Allan is a frank and cheerful young man who is well-liked by both young and old. He is also recognized for holding high ideals.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)_

## History

Allan and her husband, the new minister, visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea, where she tasted an inedible layer cake baked by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fled to her room in distress over the baking mistake, Allan followed her upstairs to comfort her, kindly forgiving the error and connecting with her as a kindred spirit. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited Allan to celebrate the triumphant news of tying for first place on the Island on her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan serves as a kind confidante and friend to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her role as the new minister's wife. Their bond deepens when Mrs. Allan compassionately comforts a devastated [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after she accidentally flavors a tea cake with liniment, forgiving the mistake and revealing herself to be a kindred spirit. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later seeks out Mrs. Allan to share her personal triumph after tying for first place on the Island's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), +10 more_
